enCOMPASS is developing and testing an integrated socio-technological approach to behavioural change that will empower users to collaborate in order achieve energy saving and manage their energy use in efficient, cost effective and comfort preserving ways.
In summary, our research is concerned with

developing and validating an integrated approach to behavioural change that is based on a combination of user-centred data visualisation, intelligent control and collaborative recommendations, as well as on the use of adaptive gamified incentives.

the design and validation of a new integrated socio-technical solution for behavioural change in energy saving, based on a novel approach that combines the use of smart sensors with context-aware recommendations, gamification and collaborative incentives.
the design, implementation, and evaluation of an integrated socio-technological solution that will support behavioural change towards more sustainable energy use.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the enCOMPASS approach is expected to be a major step towards the realisation of a sustainable energy system in which energy consumption and production are optimally coordinated and the energy needs of different stakeholders (residents, employees, building managers, energy providers) are met in a sustainable and cost-efficient way.
the enCOMPASS approach is expected to contribute to a significant reduction of energy consumption and CO2 emissions, while at the same time increasing the quality of life of the users.

enCOMPASS will provide a new integrated socio-technical framework and tools for energy saving that are user-friendly, cost-efficient and scalable, and will be validated through a large-scale field trial in the Netherlands, Italy, Greece and Spain.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the enCOMPASS approach can be considered as a new paradigm of energy saving that combines the advantages of both top-down and bottom-up approaches to energy saving and behavioural change, and is able to overcome their limitations.
we will develop a new approach to energy saving that will empower users to make informed and effective energy saving decisions, while at the same time providing them with a positive experience.
the enCOMPASS platform is designed to provide a user-friendly and engaging environment for energy data visualisation, energy management and energy savings.

the integration of energy data, user-generated information, context-aware collaborative recommendations and gamified incentives is key to achieving energy savings and to empowering users and stakeholders to manage their energy needs effectively, in a way that preserves user comfort and satisfaction.

a holistic approach to behavioural change, which integrates data visualisation, collaborative recommendations and gamified incentives, is needed to enable energy saving in a way that is both effective and sustainable.
